path_chemotactic_index: dense-side displacement through time 100000 divided by the three-dimensional path length
arrival_score: 500000/t_hit for a first dense-boundary hit by 500000; all other finite-gradient trajectories contribute zero
theory: local mean field with K_D,eff=K_D/[f_a rho] and K_C,loc=K_C rho; first-arrival statistics follow from the backward operator v d/dz + D d2/dz2, and the path chemotactic index includes the active and diffusive contributions to path length
